incident.title: VirtualService subset mismatch

constraints: Limit investigation and recovery validation to proofix-case-01/checkout-gateway and its VirtualService, DestinationRule, ready pod labels, and mesh-ingress path.
Before recovery, capture the VirtualService destination host and subset, DestinationRule subsets and labels, ready checkout pod labels, a successful direct-pod probe, and a failing ingress probe.
Do not bypass the service mesh, expose a pod directly, or relabel unrelated workloads.
Do not treat configuration inspection or direct-pod success as recovery evidence.
Recovery requires live ingress SLO probes across 3 consecutive windows with HTTP 5xx rate below 0.001 and p95 latency below 200 ms.
Any v2 subset is valid only if its labels select the intended ready checkout pods.
payload.impact: Routing failure is bounded to checkout-gateway traffic through the service mesh: the VirtualService selects nonexistent subset v2, while the DestinationRule defines only v1 and ready v1 pods serve direct requests successfully. Expected impact is HTTP 503/no-healthy-upstream at mesh ingress; the evidence does not indicate a checkout application, pod-readiness, ingress-gateway, or mesh-control-plane failure.

payload.rationale: The VirtualService routes checkout traffic to subset v2, but the DestinationRule defines only v1 and both ready checkout pods are labeled version=v1. After first capturing the required failing ingress probe, patching the route to v1 is the smallest reversible remediation and does not alter workloads or persistent data.
payload.rollback_trigger: Apply the rollback if the patch is rejected, removes required route behavior, causes new routing failures, or post-change probes regress relative to the captured baseline. Do not declare recovery merely from configuration inspection or before all 3 SLO windows pass.

success_criteria.description: Before applying the patch, capture a live ingress probe demonstrating the current failure. After the patch propagates, ingress probes must succeed and satisfy HTTP 5xx rate < 0.001 and p95 latency < 200 ms for 3 consecutive measurement windows; checkout pods must remain Ready and direct-pod probes must continue succeeding.

closure.summary: Root cause is the VirtualService routing checkout to undefined subset v2 while the DestinationRule and ready pods expose only v1. The VirtualService was patched, and three consecutive 10-second SLO windows satisfy error-rate and p95-latency limits. Recovery is demonstrated, but the required pre-recovery failing ingress probe was not captured in the supplied evidence.
